protocol.react: React 19.3 + React Compiler with keyed row components owning useState
protocol.runtime: OXC-generated component and state-site metadata; structural updates expand components and use keyed VDOM reconciliation
protocol.timing: Programmatic click to synchronous host commit; mount reported separately; layout, paint, and display presentation excluded.

limitations: Three page loads share one Chrome 155 profile and one MacIntel device; each page is the replication unit and 24 pairs are nested observations.
Structural parent updates use full component expansion plus keyed VDOM reconciliation; this is not a graph-selected structural fast path.
React Compiler is enabled; source render counters are omitted to avoid changing compiler memoization.
Filter-half runtime p95 is 85.6 ms on one page and 312.9–314.6 ms on two pages despite page medians near 31–32 ms; the tail cause is unknown and must remain visible.
The benchmark excludes layout, paint, display presentation, repeated churn memory, and lifecycle instrumentation.
OXC lowers the checked-in TSX component and state-site fixture; the structural operation callback is supplied by the harness.
